##
Couldn't I just hire someone to feed me lines through an ear piece?  lol Just kidding, this is great.

I used to like the color orange...but I swear to God if I see one more orange cone on my commute to work, I'm going to go all Michael Douglas on them, get me a bazooka and really give them something to fix!

Everywhere we turned the streets were closed, funny thing is, I don't see them working. There is a LOT of standing around, drinking beverages, and my favorite, 4-6 guys watching one guy work.  Meanwhile we had to have a tire replaced due to how bad the roads are.

By day three, I felt so at peace and connected to everything around me and full of energy. 

No where near feeling like I was going to die, it's best not to tell anyone.

Are you me? lol 

I did this exact thing this weekend.  I was finally at 193 (after being above 200 for a long time) after a dry fast 2 weekends ago, now 198 this morning with all that I ate this past weekend.  Emotions really play a big part in the bingeing and without self-discipline, it can snowball out of control.  I think the important thing is not to beat oneself up.  At least we are aware that something that happened or didn't happen led us to overindulging.  I'm trying to stop myself from letting these feelings get out of control and more importantly, finding something else I can do that doesn't involve comfort foods.

I just started dry fasting this morning and hope to keep going down on the scale, we learn as we go.

Is this career something you wish to do forever, or have you yearned to start a business?  If it's the latter, and your computer history isn't tracked at work, you could begin searching for ideas and doing research, saving as much money as possible in the meantime.  If it's the former, then you could help the company grow by looking for more clients/business, even if it's not in your job description, however, I suspect they probably already have a marketing team that does that.

I think you should still save as much money as possible, just in case they realize that your position there is superfluous and let you go.

Asking me to make copies for them, or "I need this right away, scan and email it to me."  Stuff that had nothing to do with what they retained us for and it's usually because they are disorganized and can't find xyz document.

items.title: FICO score decreased
items.text:
FICO score decreased
Hi all,
My FICO score went from 864 to 824 and there are two reasons listed:
-Lack of recent installment loan info
-Two few accounts currently paid as agreed

I have no debt, 3 open credit cards, where I only use one of them for all purchases.  All bills are always paid on time.  I recently returned a lease and all those payments were done on time as well and the 40 point decline occurred now 4/5/19-I returned the car last week of January 2019.

I'm looking to buy a car, should I take out a loan just so I can improve/expand my credit history.  I hate to have to 1) pay interest instead of trying to pay cash or 2) owe any money.
Any advice greatly appreciated, thank you!

Edit:  They really strike the fear of God in you, making you worry about your score, now I can relax. Thank you all!
I was so hyper after the episode.  I felt like I had 4 espressos, I knew I was going to have trouble going to sleep.

You may want to look up the law in your State for example, here in NJ it is not required to give notice:

**Q.**  Do I have to give notice when I am terminating or discharging an  employee? Must an employee give notice of their intention to quit?  
**A.**  No. Notice is not required by either party based on the fact that New  Jersey is an "employment at will" state, meaning that an employer or  employee may terminate the relationship at any time, without a reason,  without cause. 

I work for an attorney as well and often wonder if a future employer calls him to see if I'm a good employee, if he would be resentful that I left and vindictive and give a bad review.  Also, prepare what you will say at a future job interview if they ask you why did you leave.

Good luck!
